metadata.source: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4.pdf
metadata.chunk_id: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4_p2_1

text:
## 1. INTRODUCTION

This Procedure Order covers the Methodology of Imposing / Alteration and Cancellation of  Temporary  Speed  Restrictions  on  Line  Nos.  '3'  &  '4'  equipped  with  Signalling  & Train Control System of SIEMENS.

metadata.source: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4.pdf
metadata.chunk_id: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4_p1_3

text:
## 2. SCOPE

This  procedure  shall  be read  in  conjunction  with  the  Metro  Railways  General  Rules,  2020, Safety Circulars and other instructions in vogue for Working of Trains on Line Nos. '3' & '4'.

metadata.source: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4.pdf
metadata.chunk_id: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4_p2_5

text:
3.1 All the request for imposition/ alteration/ cancellation of TSR on main line should be made to chief controller/OCC and the CC/OCC  shall instruct Traffic Controller for the Imposition / Alteration/Cancellation  of  Temporary  Speed  Restrictions  &  Issue  of  Caution  Orders  to Train operators, as required on the Main Line Sections.
3.2 In  cases  of  any  of  the  TSR  Commands,  not  directly  being  under  Control  of  TC,  the Compliance  of  the  same  shall  be  ensured  by  TC  by  the  Station  Controllers  on  the Exchange of Private Numbers.
3.3 All Requests for the Imposition / Alteration/Cancellation of Temporary Speed Restrictions & Issue of Caution Orders to the Train Operators, as required within the Depot, shall be submitted  to  the  Depot  Controller,  who  is  responsible  for  Coordination  of  all  such Requests.  Depot  Controller  shall  also  inform  the  TSR  details  to  the  PPIO,  under Exchange  of  Private  Numbers,  to  enable  him  to  advise  the  Shunting  Supervisors accordingly.
3.4 All  Requests of  the  TSRs  shall  be  submitted by  the  Authorized  Personnel  of  Rank, not less than Junior Engineers as per prescribed format in Annexure-'C .

metadata.source: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4.pdf
metadata.chunk_id: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4_p2_8

text:
3.4 All  Requests of  the  TSRs  shall  be  submitted by  the  Authorized  Personnel  of  Rank, not less than Junior Engineers as per prescribed format in Annexure-'C .
3.5 On receipt of Request for Imposition / Alteration & Cancellation of Temporary Speed Restriction (TSR) on a Section / in the Depot, the Traffic Controller / Depot Controller shall verify the TC No. corresponding to the OHE Mast No. from the Conversion Table at Annexure - 'A' to this Circular and shall take further action for Imposition / Alteration / Cancellation of the Temporary Speed Restriction.
The  Requests,  arising  out  of  Emergency  or  Failure,  shall  be  taken  up  promptly,  duly advising the Official, who has made the Request.
The Requests for the TSRs for a Planned Work shall normally be submitted before 1700 Hrs. of the previous day.
Traffic Controller / Depot  Controller shall  keep a record of  accepted  TSR Requests.
3.6 TSRs can be Imposed / Altered (only Decrease) by the Traffic Controller from ATS MMI & Central VDU, available in OCC for Line Nos. '3' & '4' or by Station or Depot

metadata.source: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4.pdf
metadata.chunk_id: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4_p2_9

text:
## Introduction

Controller  from  the  VDU.  However,  only  Station  or  Depot  Controller  from  VDU  can Cancel / Alter (Increase or Decrease) TSRs, in coordination with JE / Signal, who shall turn  the  Key  in  Rememo  Box,  provided  in  the  SER,(this  key  should  be  turned  within 20secs  of  command  of  cancellation  given)  as  per  Procedure  for  cancellation  / Alteration. For this Station or Depot Controller shall give a written Request to the JE / Signal as given by engineering department. After Cancellation / Alteration (Increase or Decrease) of the TSRs, the Station or Depot Controller shall give these details to the Traffic Controller, who shall in turn verify these details from the Central VDU.

## Introduction

If  the  Imposition  of  TSR  is  not  possible  by  ATS  MMI  &  Central  VDU,  it  shall  be advised  to  the  Train  Operator  in  Writing  by  the  Station  Controller  and  it  shall  be  the responsibility  of  Train  Operator  to  observe  the  Temporary  Speed  Restriction.  In Emergency, the Caution Order can be repeated to the Train Operator of the first Train approaching the affected area on Radio, under Exchange of Private Numbers.

## Note:

(i) The Value of the TSR to be imposed on a particular Track circuit in particular Direction  of  Travel  must  be  less  than  that  of  Permanent  Speed  Restriction (PSR) Value on that Track circuit in the specified Direction of Travel.
(ii)  In 'SIEMENS' System, the ATS Entry of the TSR shall be 4 Kmph lower than the Limit Value (Operational Speed).

## 3.7 Criterion of Speed Restrictions to be Followed:

3.8 The  Traffic  Controller  shall  advise  the  Depot  Controller  &  Station  Controllers  of  the Terminal Stations of all TSRs to be in force during next day on the entire Mainline on daily basis and shall maintain a Record of the same. Traffic Controller shall also advise the TSRs to the Crew Controller and the Crew Controller and depot controller shall write in  the  notice boards and sign on register as well however for those TSRs not imposed

metadata.source: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4.pdf
metadata.chunk_id: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4_p3_6

text:
## Introduction

through  the  system  due  to  any  reason  shall  be  advised  to  Train  operators  of  each passing train in the form of caution order at the preceding station of affected section.

metadata.source: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4.pdf
metadata.chunk_id: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4_p1_0

text:
3.9 Traffic Controller shall ensure that before  the Start of Revenue Services all  the TSRs requested  on the  Section  have  been  'Set'  on  the  Sector  and  shall  advise,  under  the Exchange  of  Private  numbers,  the  first  Train  Operator  passing  the  affected  Section. Traffic Controller  will  confirm from the said TO with regard to the imposition of TSR. Train  Operator  in  turn  shall  intimate  the  Target  Speed  displayed  on  DMI  over  the affected area to the Traffic Controller. TC shall log / record the same.
3.10 On  Completion  of  Imposition  /  Alteration  /  Cancellation  of  the  TSRs,  the  Status  of imposed  TSRs  shall  be  verified  by  the  Traffic  Controller  /  Depot  Controller  by visualizing  the Numeric  Value against the concerned track circuits.  Complete  List of TSRs shall be reconciled by the Traffic Controller in case of Alteration (s) in TSR.
3.11 In the event of complete Power Failure to the Track side ATC System trains run in degraded  mode  of  train  operation  with  speed  not  exceeding  25kmph  hence  all TSRs  below  25  kmph  shall  be  dealt  as  per point  3.12 of  this  circular.  After restoration,  Chief  controller  shall  verify  that  all  TSRs  which  are  prevailing  have been applied in the system.

metadata.source: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4.pdf
metadata.chunk_id: 23.2 SC-23B (Rev-03)  Temporary Speed Restrictions in L- 3&4_p4_2

text:
3.12 Since Trains can run in non-ATP Mode at Speeds lower than 25 Kmph, the System as such can not enforce the TSRs of Values less than 25 Kmph in non-ATP Mode of Working. TSRs of Values less than 25 Kmph shall, therefore, be advised to the Train  Operator  in  writing  in  the  form  of  caution  order  by  the  preceding  stations controller of the station. Such an Advise shall be in addition to the TSR imposed by the System.
3.13 All TSRs in the Depot shall be advised in writing to the Train Operators.
3.14 The Depot Controller shall advise the TSRs in writing or on phone, under the Exchange of  Private  Numbers,  to  the  Maintenance  Rail  Vehicles,  whenever  the  Traffic  Block  is granted to them.
3.15 The  Drivers  of  Maintenance  Rail  Vehicles  shall  respect  and  follow  the  Caution Orders advised to them, while moving on Main Line / Depot line.
3.16 Format of the Caution Order for advising the TSRs to the Train Operators is enclosed at Annexure - 'B' to this Circular.
3.17 During high speed testing of train, trains run in non-ATP mode (SCS cut out/ATP bypass). During such testing, temporary speed restrictions above 25 kmph should also be advised to the train operators of testing trains at the preceding stations in the form of caution order.

## SAFETY CIRCULAR -04)
## Procedure Order for Imposition & Cancellation of Temporary Speed Restrictions and Issue of Caution Orders on Line 7 & 9

## 1. INTRODUCTION

This Procedure Order covers the Methodology of Imposing and Cancellation of  Temporary Speed Restrictions  on  Line 7  &  9  equipped  with  Signaling  &  Train  Control  System  of Bombardier.

## 2. SCOPE

This procedure shall be read in conjunction with the Metro Railways General Rules, 2020 and its Amendments, Safety Circulars and other instructions in vogue for Working of Trains on Line 7 & 9. For UTO mode of Train Operation: wherever Train Operator (TO) is mentioned, it is to be read as Train Operator (TO)/ Roving Attendant (RA)/ Emergency Train Operator (ETO).

3.1 All  the  requests for  imposition/cancellation of  TSR  on  main line  should be made to  Chief Controller/OCC,  and  the  CHC/OCC  shall instruct Traffic Controller for the Imposition/ Cancellation of Temporary Speed Restrictions & Issue of Caution Orders to Train operators, as required on the Main Line Sections.
3.2 In cases of any of the TSR Commands, not directly being under Control of TC, the Compliance of the same shall be ensured by TC through the Station Controllers on the Exchange of Private Numbers.
3.3 All  Requests  for  the  Imposition/Cancellation  of  Temporary  Speed  Restrictions  &  Issue  of Caution Orders to the Train Operators in case of non-UTO operation, as required within the Depot, shall be  submitted to the Depot Controller, who is responsible for  Coordination of all such  Requests.  Depot  Controller  shall  also  inform  the  TSR  details  to  the  PPIO,  under Exchange of Private Numbers, to enable him to advise the Shunting Supervisors accordingly. In case depot control is with OCC, TSR can be imposed from OCC for Line-7 only. However, system imposed TSR is not applicable in case of Depot on line-9.
3.4 All Requests of the TSRs shall be submitted by the Authorized Personnel of Rank, not less than Junior Engineer as per prescribed format in Annexure- B.

3.4 All Requests of the TSRs shall be submitted by the Authorized Personnel of Rank, not less than Junior Engineer as per prescribed format in Annexure- B.
3.5 On receipt of Request for Imposition/Cancellation of Temporary Speed Restriction (TSR) on a Section /  in  the  Depot,  the  Traffic  Controller /  Depot  Controller shall  verify  the  Track Segment Number/s corresponding to the OHE Mast Nos. from SGC & TPC and shall take further  action  for  Imposition /  Cancellation  of  the  Temporary  Speed  Restriction  by  referring ----7.  Track  Segments means blocks of smaller length which are parts of any track section to facilitate imposition of TSR on a limited area and thus not affect the entire length of track section.
3.6 The Requests, arising out of Emergency or Failure, shall be taken up promptly, duly advising the Official, who has made the Request.
3.7 The Requests for the TSRs for a Planned Work shall normally be submitted before 1700 Hrs. of the previous day.
3.8 Traffic Controller / Depot Controller shall keep a record of accepted TSR Requests.

## Introduction

3.9
## i. Applicable for Line-7 only

## i. Applicable for Line-7 only

TSRs can be implemented through central/local ATS/ VDU for main line and Depots in terms of affected Track segments and, therefore, the Traffic  Controller / Depot Controller shall prepare the details of Caution Orders, as required, by converting the Chainages/mast number in terms of the affected Track Segments.
## ii. Applicable for Line-9 only

TSRs can be implemented through central/local ATS/ VDU for main line in terms of affected Track segments and, therefore, the Traffic Controller  shall  prepare  the details  of Caution Orders, as required, by converting the Chainages/mast number in terms of the affected Track Segments.
3.10 A.  (applicable  for  Line-7  only) TSRs  shall  be  imposed  by  the  Traffic  Controller/Chief Controller/Station Controller/Depot controller. However, TSRs shall be cancelled by Chief Controller/Station  Controller/Depot  Controller  through  CATS /  LATS / DATS (SCR / DCC MMI)/VDU respectively
OCC TC MMI/LATS / DATS (SCR / DCC MMI) are available in Line-7 at following locations: -
(i) OCC/BCC Traffic Controller MMI for whole line and Depot.
(ii) Mukundpur Depot including test track section
(iii) Majlis Park Controlling region 1 (from Majlis Park station to Netaji Subhash place station).
(iv) Shakurpur/MYPI/DDSC (Controlling region 2 from Shakurpur station to Durgabai Deshmukh South Campus station)
(v) Lajpat  Nagar/Hazrat  Nizamuddin  (Controlling  region  3  from  Moti  Bagh  station  to  Hazrat Nizamuddin station)
(vi) IP  Extension/Mayur Vihar Pocket  -1 (Controlling region  4 from  Mayur vihar  station to  IP Extension station)

(vi) IP  Extension/Mayur Vihar Pocket  -1 (Controlling region  4 from  Mayur vihar  station to  IP Extension station)

After restoration, Chief controller shall verify that all TSRs which are prevailing have been applied in the system.
3.17 Since Trains can run in non-ATP Mode at Speeds lower than 25 Kmph, the System as such cannot enforce the TSRs of Values less than 25 Kmph in non-ATP Mode of Working. In case value of TSR imposed is  less  than  25  kmph  and  need  arises  for  train  movement  in  degraded  mode, TC/OCC shall instruct nearest available RA/ETO to board (If already not on board) the train as per procedure. RA/ETO shall take the charge of the train. Value of TSR shall be advised to the Train Operator in writing in the form of caution order by the station controller of the preceding station or by Traffic Controller under exchange of private number (if train has already left preceding station). Such an advice shall be in addition to the TSR imposed by the System.

## 5. CATS/LATS MMI Display Problem Management

(i) In case of CATS/LATS MMI displaying problem, Traffic Controller/Station Controller shall confirm all the information displayed by the LVS/VDU for monitoring.
(ii)  In case of incoherence of ATS information displayed between CATS MMI and LVS, Traffic Controller  shall  verify  the  equipment  status  on  LATS  MMI  or  VDU  through  Station Controller,  before  giving  authorization  to  make  a  specific  train  movement  in  degraded mode.
(iii) In  case  of  unavailability  of  Large  Video Screen at OCC, according to data displayed on CATS MMI, if the Traffic Controller has to take a decision for giving an authorization to train operator to pass a red signal or an on signal related to a failure of TS(Track Section), he shall get the confirmation from the station controller that all the information displayed by the CATS MMI is consistent with those displayed by LATS MMI or VDU in operation.

text:
## (ii)    TIME TABLE ONLINE

(a)ONLINE  TIMETABLE  has  reconcile  and  reassignment  options.  If  a  train  doesn't stop at normal stopping point on a platform then ATS can't detect its journey of train for that platform and train ID will be lost at next platform. So operator need to reconcile journey of the train for that particular platform from online time table.
(b)If due to some failure in train time table of that rake need to be assigned to some other train replacing failed train then reassignment option of online timetable will be used.
(c)All other online time table modifications are not implemented as of now. Changes will  apply for  only  current  Timetable,  and  have  no  effect  to  the  stored schedule.

(i) There are total 11 CBTC zone in Line 8 including depot and stabling line. For each zone CBTC zone train hold button is provided on ATS MMI/VDU. If CBTC zone train hold is activated EB will be applied in all trains in this CBTC zone.
(ii) To set CBTC zone Train hold left clicks on 'SC8XX' button a confirmation dialogue will appear to activate CBTC zone train hold.

(ii) To  release  train  hold  or  skip  station  left  click  on  'TH'  or  'SS'  button,  a  confirmation dialogue will appear to confirm release of train hold or skip station
(a)  If manual skip is applied on platform neither skip announcement will be done in the train regarding next station nor 'Non stopping train' display will be sent to platform display board. Skip announcement will only be done if it is a planned skip from time table. However train will get Skip command in both manual and planned skip station.
(b)  If  Manual  skip  is  applied  for  a  platform  by  TC/SC  Station  controller  shall  do manual announcement regarding 'Non stopping train'.

text:
## Emergency mode Purpose of emergency mode activation:-

(i) In case of emergency ahead in tunnel/elevated section, if following train need to go back to previous station emergency mode can be used. CBTC trains moves back to previous station following emergency route. Emergency route can be set in opposite direction to a set normal route without cancelling it. Emergency route has first priority over controlling movement of train running under supervision of CAB signals.

Ventilation  block  enable/disable  button  is  provided  on  ATS  MMI  for  underground  stations separately for up and down line. text:
## 9.3 Route with flank track

(i) A route is set with its approach track occupied, now if flank track to this route is occupied then start signal of route will change to danger immediately and automatic release timer of this route will be activated. When timer is stopped, start signal of the route remain danger and  route  still  remain  controlled  by  OC.  To  release  this  route  manual  route  release command shall be given.
(ii) A route is set with its approach track is free, now if flank track to this route is occupied then start signal of route will change to danger immediately and route still remains controlled by OC. To release this route manual route release command shall be given.
9.4 TSR shall be applied and released only when route locking of that track is in released condition.
9.5 When 'violet' aspect of repeater signal or red aspect of corresponding main signal is failed then aspect of main and repeater signal on ATS/VDU will be shown as blank. In this scenario TC/SC shall authorize train movement as per degraded mode train operation procedure.

## SAFETY CIRCULAR - 23 'G' (Rev.-01)
## PROCEDURE ORDER FOR IMPOSITION / ALTERATION & CANCELLATION OF TEMPORARY SPEED RESTRICTIONS AND ISSUE OF CAUTION ORDERS ON LINE-1

## 1. INTRODUCTION

This  Procedure  Order  covers  the  Methodology  of  Imposing  /  Alteration  and  Cancellation  of Temporary Speed Restrictions on Line-1, equipped with Interlocking system & ATP system by ALSTOM and ATS by BEL-DMRC.

## 2. SCOPE

This  Document  should  be  read  in  conjunction  with  Metro  Railways  General  Rules-2020  and Metro Railways General (Amendment) Rules-2022, Station Working Orders in vogue and other Special Instructions issued, from time to time for Working of Trains on Line-1.

3.1 All  the  request  for  imposition/alteration/cancellation  of  TSR  on  main  line  should  be  made  to chief  controller/OCC  and  the  CC/OCC  shall  instruct  Traffic  Controller  for  the  Imposition  / Alteration/Cancellation  of  Temporary  Speed  Restrictions  &  Issue  of  Caution  Orders  to  Train operators, as required on the Main Line Sections.
3.2 In cases of any of the TSR Commands, not directly being under Control of TC, the Compliance of  the  same  shall  be  ensured  by  TC  by  the  Station  Controllers  on  the  Exchange  of  Private Numbers.
3.3 All  Requests  for  the  Imposition  /  Alteration/Cancellation  of  Temporary  Speed  Restrictions  & Issue of Caution Orders to the Train Operators, as required within the Depot, shall be submitted to  the  Depot  Controller,  who  is  responsible  for  Coordination  of  all  such  Requests.  Depot Controller shall also inform the TSR details to the PPIO, under Exchange of Private Numbers, to enable him to advise the Shunting Supervisors accordingly.
3.4 All Requests of the TSRs shall be submitted by the Authorized Personnel of Rank, not less than Junior Engineers as per prescribed format in Annexure - 'C' .

3.4 All Requests of the TSRs shall be submitted by the Authorized Personnel of Rank, not less than Junior Engineers as per prescribed format in Annexure - 'C' .
3.5 (a)    On  receipt  of  Request  for  Imposition  /  Alteration  &  Cancellation  of  Temporary  Speed Restriction (TSR) on a Section / in the Depot, the Traffic Controller / Depot Controller shall verify  the  TC  No.  corresponding  to  the  OHE  Mast  No.  from  the  Conversion  Table  at Annexure - 'A' to  this  Circular  and  shall  take  further  action  for  Imposition  /  Alteration  / Cancellation of the Temporary Speed Restriction.
(b)   The Requests for the TSRs for a Planned Work shall normally be submitted before 1700 Hrs. of the previous day.
(c)   Traffic Controller / Depot Controller shall keep a record of accepted TSR Requests.
3.6 The TSR Requests, arising out of Emergency or Failure during revenue hours, shall be taken up  promptly,  TC  shall  ensure  implementation  of  such  TSR,  from  the  first  train  operator, who is passing the affected section under exchange of private numbers, the train operator in turn shall intimate the target speed displayed on DMI over the affected section.TC shall log/record the same.
3.7 (a)   TSRs can be implemented through central ATS / ATP System for main line and DATS for  Depots in terms of affected Track circuits and, therefore, the Traffic Controller /

## Introduction

Depot  Controller  shall  prepare  the  Caution  Orders,  as  required,  by  converting  the Chainages in terms of the affected Track Circuit Zone.

## Introduction

(b)    However,  if  required  TSRs  can  be  Imposed  /  Altered  (both  Increase  &  Decrease)  & Cancelled by the Station/Depot Controller from LATS/DATS (SCR/DCC MMI) respectively.
## List of Controlling LATS/DATS for sections in L-1

## List of Controlling LATS/DATS for sections in L-1

(i) Shaheed Sathal (New Bus Adda) for NBAA- ATHA section
(ii) Arthala for NBAA-ATHA section
(iii) Rajendra Nagar for MNGM-SHDN section
(iv) Dilshad Garden for DSG-MPK Section.
(v) Shahdara for SHD-TZI Section.
(vi) Shastri Park for SHD-TZI Section.
(vii) Tis Hazari for SHD-TZI Section.
(viii) ILOK for PBGH-KN Section.
(ix) Pitampura for KP-PTP Section.
(x) Rithala for RHE-RI Section.
(xi) Shastri Park Depot for Test Track at SHPKD.
(c)    TSRs  can  be  Imposed  /  Altered  (only  Decrease)  by  the  Traffic  Controller  from CATS MMI, available in OCC for Line No. '1'.
(d)   TSR increase/Cancellation is possible only from LATS MMI in case of ATS which shall be done by Station Controller.
(e)    If  the  Imposition  of  TSR  is  not  possible  by  ATS  MMI,  it  shall  be  imposed  using  ATC Maintenance  Terminal  available at the SER  of  corresponding  Interlocking  Station. Activities on ATC Maintenance Terminal, however, shall be carried out by the Signalling Maintenance Staff.
## ATC Maintenance Terminals are available at:

## ATC Maintenance Terminals are available at:

(i) New Bus Adda SMR for NBAA-ATHA Section.
(ii) Rajendra Nagar SMR for MNGM-SHDN Section
(iii) Dilshad Garden SMR for DSG-MPK section
(iv) Shastri Park SER for SHD-TZI Section.
(v) ILOK SER for PBGH-KN Section.
(vi) Pitampura SER for KP-PTP Section.
(vii) Rithala SER for RHE-RI Section.
(viii) Shastri Park Depot SER for Test Track at SHPKD.
(f)        If  the  Imposition  of TSR is not possible even by ATC Maintenance Terminal, it shall be advised to the Train Operator of each passing train in Writing by the Station Controller in the form of caution order and it shall be the responsibility of Train Operator to observe the Temporary Speed Restriction. In Emergency, the Caution Order can be repeated to the Train Operator of the first Train approaching the affected area on Radio, under Exchange of Private Numbers and following trains shall be issued caution orders.

## Note:

(i) The Value of the TSR to be imposed on a particular Track circuit in particular Direction of Travel must be less than that of Permanent Speed Restriction (PSR) Value on that Track circuit in the specified Direction of Travel.

## Note:

(ii) The ATS Entry of the TSR must be the same as the Limit Value (the Operational Speed). However, the Target Speed as visible to 'TO' on the DMI / MMI shall be '5 Kmph' less than the Operational Speed.
## 3.8 Speed Restrictions, as imposable by ATS/ATP System:

## 3.8 Speed Restrictions, as imposable by ATS/ATP System:

*As maximum PSR on line-1 is 80 Kmph, hence TSR more than 80 Kmph cannot be applied.
3.9 The Traffic  Controller  shall  advise  the  Depot  Controller  &  Station  Controllers  of  the  Terminal Stations of all TSRs to be in force during next day on the entire Mainline on daily basis and shall maintain  a  Record  of  the  same.  Traffic  Controller  shall  also  advise  the  TSRs  to  the  Crew Controller and the Crew Controller and depot controller shall write in the notice boards and sign on register as well however for those TSRs not imposed through the system due to any reason shall  be  advised  to  Train  operators  of  each  passing  train  in  the  form  of  caution  order  at  the preceding station of affected section.
3.10 Traffic  Controller  shall  ensure  that  before  the  Start  of  Revenue  Services  all  the  TSRs requested  on  the  Section  have  been  'Set'  on  the  Sector  and  shall  advise,  under  the Exchange of Private numbers, the first Train Operator passing the affected Section. Traffic Controller  will  confirm  from  the  said  TO  with  regard  to  the  imposition  of  TSR.  Train Operator in turn shall intimate the Target Speed displayed on DMI over the affected area to the Traffic Controller. TC shall log / record the same.

## Introduction

3.11 On Completion, the Status of all the TSRs shall be verified by the 'TSR Status' Request on the ATC Maintenance Terminal or by viewing the 'TSR List' appearing in TSR Overview Dialog Box of LATS/CATS MMI for the particular ATC Zone. Complete List of TSRs shall be reconciled with the Traffic Controller in case of any alteration in TSRs.

3.12 (a)   In  the  event  of  complete  Power  Failure  to  the  Track  side  ATC  System  trains  run  in degraded mode of train operation with speed not exceeding 25kmph hence all TSRs below 25 kmph shall be dealt as per para 3.13 of this circular.
(b)  After restoration, Chief controller shall verify that all TSRs which are prevailing have been applied  in  the  system.  After  imposition  of  prevailing  TSR,  Traffic  Controller  shall  ensure TSR  implementation  from  the  Train  Operator  of  first  train,  passing  the  affected  section under exchange of private numbers, Train Operator in turn shall intimate the Target Speed displayed on DMI over the affected area to the Traffic Controller. TC shall log / record the same.
3.13 Since Trains can run in non-ATP Mode at Speeds lower than 25 Kmph, the System as such cannot enforce the TSRs of Values less than 25 Kmph in non-ATP Mode of Working. TSRs of Values less than 25 Kmph shall, therefore, be advised to the Train Operator in writing in the form of caution order by the preceding stations controller of the station. Such an advice shall be in addition to the TSR imposed by the System.
3.14 All TSRs in the Depot shall be advised in writing to the Train Operators.
3.15 The Depot Controller shall advise the TSRs in writing or on phone, under the Exchange of Private Numbers, to the Maintenance Rail Vehicles, whenever the Traffic Block is granted to them.
3.16 The Drivers of Maintenance Rail Vehicles shall respect and follow the Caution Orders advised to them, while moving on Main Line / Depot line.

3.16 The Drivers of Maintenance Rail Vehicles shall respect and follow the Caution Orders advised to them, while moving on Main Line / Depot line.
3.17 Format  of  the  Caution  Order  for  advising  the  TSRs  to  the  Train  Operators  is  enclosed  at Annexure - 'B' to this Circular.
3.18 During  high  speed  testing  of  train,  trains  run  in  non-ATP  mode  (SCS  cut  out/ATP  by  pass). During such testing, temporary speed restrictions above 25 kmph should also be advised to the train operators of testing trains at the preceding stations in the form of caution order.

## PROCEDURE ORDER FOR THE MANAGEMENT OF 'TRAIN ID' DURING TRAIN OPERATION ON MAIN LINE

## 1.0 INTRODUCTION

This  Procedure  Order  details  the  Responsibilities  of  the  concerned  Metro  Staff  and  the Methodology  to  be  followed  for  the  Management  of  'Train  IDs'  during  Traffic  Operation.  The Procedure Order is applicable to all Staff related with Train Operation & Traffic Management.

## 2.0 SCOPE

This procedure shall be read in conjunction with the Metro Railways General Rules, 2020 & Metro Railways General (Amendment) Rules, 2022, Safety Circulars and other instructions in vogue.
For UTO mode of Train Operation: wherever Train Operator (TO) is mentioned, it is to be read as Train Operator (TO)/ Roving Attendant (RA)/ Emergency Train Operator (ETO).

## 3.0 GENERAL:

4.0 NECESSITY  OF  CHANGE  OF  TRAIN  IDS:  The  following  Events/  Occurrences  necessitate Change of Train IDs. Change / Swapping of Train IDs shall be done only after the approval of CHC/OCM/Dy.HOD (O): -
4.1 Delay in running of Trains: If, due to delay in running, the Trains get dissociated, the IDs of all Trains need to be replaced.

## Introduction

4.2 Late Induction of a Train from the Depot: If any Train from the Depot is late for Induction on Main Line due to any Problem/ Failure, the Train ID of this Train needs to be swapped with the IDs of Train/ Trains, which was/were supposed to follow this Train.

## Introduction

4.3 If Trains are running late and due to any Technical Problem of the System, Train IDs get lost, then same Train IDs need to be assigned again, at defined points of Berthing, in the affected Territory.
4.4 If Trains are running late and it is not possible to manage the Operations in 'Schedule Mode' on account of any Incident or Failure, the Line Running Mode may be changed to 'Constant Headway Mode'  with  'Cycle'  at  Terminals  &  'Fleet'  at  Intermediate  Terminals,  with  the  approval  of CHC/OCM/DY.HOD (O) where ever applicable.
4.5 Withdrawal of a Train Set by RSC or SGC for Maintenance / Repair in the Depot:
## Case 'A': Lines wherein 'Single Loop' Operation is in Vogue:

## Case 'A': Lines wherein 'Single Loop' Operation is in Vogue:

(a) If a Stand-by Train is available, the ID of the withdrawn Train shall be assigned to this Standby Train in order to maintain the Train Running Sequence, as per the Time Table.
(b) If a Stand-by Train is not available, there shall be no need to change the Train IDs. Trips of the withdrawn Train shall remain un-performed and shall have to be deleted from the System, using 'OTM' / 'TSUI' Window.
## Case 'B': Lines wherein 'Multiple Loop' Operations are in Vogue:

(a) If a Stand-by Train is available, the ID of the withdrawn Train shall be assigned to this Standby Train in order to maintain the Train Running Sequence, as per the Time Table.
(b) If a Stand-by Train is not available, the IDs of all Trains shall have to be changed at the End Terminal  in  order  to  maintain  the  Scheduled  Sequence  of  Trains,  on  Short  /  Long  Loop Destinations, as per the Time Table.
4.6 On Lines, wherein Multiple Loops are in Operation and if Long / Short Loop Trains are running Late, Swapping / Change of IDs shall be required to be done at Short / Long Loop terminal / Terminals in order to avoid any Route Cancellation and to maintain the Scheduled Sequence, as per the Time Table.
5.0 DUTIES  OF  OCC/  CREW  CONTROLLER/  TRAIN  OPERATORS,  WHILE  CHANGING  THE TRAIN ID:
5.1 Train IDs shall be changed under the Supervision of the Chief Controller.
5.2 Traffic Controller must be extra vigilant for Terminals and shall give Top Priority to assign ID to the Terminal Trains.
5.3 Traffic  Controller  shall  intimate  the  Crew  Controller  as  soon  as  the  decision  is  taken,  with  the approval of OCM/DGM (O) so that Crew Controller shall arrange Train Operator (TO) / Roving Attendant (RA) / Emergency Train Operator (ETO), as per availability.
5.4 Traffic Controller shall reconfirm the new Train ID to the Incoming Train Operator (TO) / Roving Attendant (RA) / Emergency Train Operator (ETO) at the Destination Point/ Crew Changing Point.

5.4 Traffic Controller shall reconfirm the new Train ID to the Incoming Train Operator (TO) / Roving Attendant (RA) / Emergency Train Operator (ETO) at the Destination Point/ Crew Changing Point.
5.5 Traffic Controller shall be responsible for keeping proper Records of the Service IDs associated with the Trains, Purpose and the Action for ID change, in the Train ID Register, which shall be duly counter-signed by the Chief Controller after each ID Change Operation.
5.6 Complete Sequence of Train IDs need to be verified after carrying out the Changes.
5.7 Traffic Controller may seek Assistance of SGC/ATS Staff, if required for assigning Train IDs.
5.8 On Line - '3', the Traffic Controller must also check the Trip ID, while allotting the new Train ID.
